summary: Encoding::for_label checked whether trimmed_pos exceeded its 19-byte buffer length after writing each byte. At position 19 the check remained false, so a twentieth byte caused an out-of-bounds panic. The fix changes both checks from > to ==, returning None before another write. The regression test added by the fix exercises this with bogusbogusbogusbogus. This is a proposed reversal; no tests were run.
expected_failure: index out of bounds: the len is 19 but the index is 19
